tsaddik: In Judaism, a tsaddik is a very righteous person.
tsaddiq: In Judaism, a tsaddiq is a very righteous person.
tsunami: A tsunami is a very large water wave formed in the ocean and can destroy buildings and people, usually due to an earthquake or volcanic eruption.
tsar: The tsar is the title of the Emperors of Russia before 1917.
Our tsar Alexander I of Russia saved us from Napoleon in 1812.
